doc.title: Bill Easley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 1, 2021

title: His parents' attitude and his father's gift of gab
summary: His mother accepted music as a career; his father was a musician out of necessity and a great talker.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So you could have obviously gone into music but did your parents want you do?

Oh I don’t think my mother — she was all right with it. My father had no interest in being a musician. He was a musician out of necessity you know, to make money. But he was more of an organizer, more of a leader of men. He had the greatest gift of gab of anybody that I’ve ever met on this planet or probably any other planet. He had the gift of gab. A lot of people think I talk a lot, they never met Bob Easley. He could talk the paint off a wall.
